steps.content: Where am I...
I think... I just saw that man again...
How long has it been... I still don't understand his darkness... I still run from it...
...Is this my dream, my ideal... This fear... It's so frightening...
There are noises.
Who... Who's out there?

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: ...You mean we can make Sosia feel fear to reverse the power here? Are you out of your mind?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hey, I think it's great. This is my expertise! Try this...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Woah, the field of fear? Sounds embarrassing. The embodiment of reality? We smashed through the Black Ring with a pipe. Who are you again?
They... fear...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What's so impressive about absorbing a B-Class Sinner? Come out and fight me!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: C-come out! I'm the Archer Queen of Syndicate, and you're in big trouble! And you need to pass the Chief first before facing me!
But why... are they still standing here...
We're all Sinners who have been baptized by Mania, who have witnessed the brutal reality and the dark, horrible abyss...
Why can THEY escape the domination of fear? Why do they have the power to fight fear while my strength is draining away?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ohhhh, she looks uncomfortable. Did I intimidate her? Let's keep doing this... Huh? What are you doing up here?
A familiar person appears in front of her.
...Is it him?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The witch's ward is trembling. Is it about to hold out?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Because you are afraid of too many things. You fear the shackles, unknown forces, and you fear that I will affect the trapped Enfer... But there's no use in hiding. Escaping is the best ingredient for fear.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Come out, Sosia. You're the only one trapped by fear.
It's because... I'm afraid? For all this time, I am the one who's been trapped by fear and can't escape?

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: You mean... I'm afraid? For all this time, I am the one who's been trapped by fear and can't escape?

steps.speaker: Sosia
steps.content: Stop dreaming! I'm her masterpiece, the embodiment of fear! I am the dominator of reality!
It's sad she still can't see that fear is the most powerful and weakest enemy. All the difficulties you encounter can be overcome, and it's only due to weakness that you can't.
To stop Witching Hour, you are your only opponent.
